slug: 2026-07-07 Beyond the Platform Understanding the Growing MOSIP Ecosystem

systems.owner: Ethiopian National ID Program (NIDP), moving to a state-owned enterprise
systems.tiers: national; 46 million registered, 13 million cards printed, 150+ agencies doing KYC, three data-centre sites, as stated by its executive director on 7 July 2026
not stated; named only as the system whose demographic data was harmonised field by field with the digital ID

systems.system: integration between the civil registration system and Fayda
systems.country_label: civil registration - ID harmonisation and integration
systems.tiers: not stated; NIDP's executive director says that when a child is born the parents' digital ID can be used to generate a digital ID for the child through the integration, and that major life events are pushed from one system to the other (7 July 2026)

note: A webinar on the MOSIP ecosystem. For Ethiopia it describes the identity system and its link to the civil registration system (exchange); it does not say how, where or in how many offices births or deaths are registered, so there is no fact for the civil class.
